name: nightshift-provider-historical-usage-backfill
instr:
Nightshift cannot backfill locally available Claude, Codex, and Copilot usage over inclusive date ranges. Implement this for providers from `providers.NewClaudeWithPath`, `providers.NewCodexWithPath`, and `providers.NewCopilotWithPath`.

Return stable, date-ordered daily observations through `Provider.UsageHistory`. Claude retains daily aggregation and session fallback semantics. Codex derives daily increments from cumulative session counters, ignores malformed evidence, and deduplicates overlapping records and sessions. Copilot exposes only Nightshift-owned request-counter history, preserves monthly resets, and marks unavailable daily detail incomplete. Local evidence remains authoritative. Cancellation returns an error without successful partial history.

Make imports atomic and expose only committed generations. Replace overlapping provider dates while preserving dates outside the request. Repeated, overlapping, empty, cancelled, and failed imports leave one coherent view. Failures preserve the prior generation and next coverage summary for retry; identical retries commit one complete replacement generation. Empty valid imports commit zero-count receipts without snapshots.

Historical queries combine live and committed observations without duplicate identities, expose origin, and preserve ordering and empty-result behavior through `Collector.GetHistory`.
